text: February nineteen fifty-nine. Nine hikers die on a mountain in Russia.
asr: February 1959, nine hikers die on a mountain in Russia.

text: Exhibit one. Their tent was cut open from the inside.
sub: The tent was cut open *from the inside*

text: Exhibit two. They ran into thirty below. Most had no shoes.
asr: Exhibit two. They ran into 30 below. Most had no shoes.

text: Exhibit three. Some had broken ribs and skulls, but no sign of a fight.
sub: Broken ribs and skulls. *No sign of a fight.*

text: What happened? An avalanche? A secret weapons test? Or something else?
asr: What happened in Avalanche, a secret weapons test, or something else?

text: Case still open. What's your verdict?
asr: Case still open. What's your verdict?
